questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "turnover" mean?
options: The number of shares a company issued
The number of new companies listed on the exchange
The profit earned by a single company
The total amount of money traded in the market that day
questions.explain_en: Turnover refers to the total value of all trades that occurred in the market that day.
questions.explain_zh: 「turnover」指的是當天市場所有成交的總金額。
